record.paper_title:
AIM Workshop “Pólya-Schur-Lax Problems: Hyperbolicity and Stability
Preservers” — A List of Open Problems
record.original_question:
For a subset Ω of the complex plane and π_n(Ω), the class of all
univariate polynomials of degree at most n whose zeros
all lie in Ω, describe all linear operators T such that T maps every
polynomial in π_n(Ω) either to a polynomial whose
zeros still all lie in Ω or to the zero polynomial.

evidence.quote: Problem 8. Describe all linear operators T : πn (Ω) → π(Ω) ∪ {0} for n ∈ N. Remark 1. Problems 7–8 originate from the works of Laguerre and Pólya-Schur and were explicitly stated first by T. Craven and G.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Omega \subseteq \mathbb{C}$ be a fixed subset of the complex plane, and let $n \in \mathbb{N}$. Denote by $\pi_n(\Omega)$ the set of all univariate complex polynomials of degree at most $n$ all of whose zeros lie in $\Omega$, and let $\pi(\Omega) = \bigcup_{n\ge 0}\pi_n(\Omega)$. 

Give a complete description (classification) of all linear operators 
$$T : \pi_n(\Omega) \longrightarrow \pi(\Omega) \cup \{0\}$$
that map every polynomial in $\pi_n(\Omega)$ either to a polynomial whose zeros all lie in $\Omega$ or to the zero polynomial. The problem is to characterize such operators $T$ for every $n \in \mathbb{N}$ and for general subsets $\Omega$ of $\mathbb{C}$.
artifact.status_search_result: For Ω being a closed circular domain (disks, half-planes, complements thereof, or the real line), Borcea and Brändén gave a complete characterization of linear operators preserving polynomials with all zeros in Ω, both in finite-degree and infinite-degree settings (Annals of Math. 2009; Invent. Math. 2009). Subsequent work treated additional cases such as strips (Brändén–Chasse–Forsgård 2014). However, for general subsets Ω ⊆ ℂ the classification problem remains open; the finite-degree problem Pn(Ω) → π(Ω) ∪ {0} for arbitrary Ω is not resolved.

status_evidence.title: Pólya-Schur master theorems for circular domains and their boundaries
status_evidence.snippet: Characterize all linear operators on finite or infinite-dimensional polynomial spaces that preserve the property of having the zero set inside a prescribed region Ω⊆ℂ for arbitrary closed circular domains Ω.
status_evidence.claim: Classification known for closed circular domains Ω.

status_evidence.title: The Lee-Yang and Pólya-Schur Programs. I
status_evidence.snippet: Linear operators preserving stability; characterization for half-plane case.
status_evidence.claim: Resolves Problem 8 in the half-plane (stability) case.

status_evidence.title: Classification theorems for operators preserving zeros in a strip
status_evidence.snippet: Operators preserving zeros in a strip.
status_evidence.claim: Extends classification to strips, but general Ω remains open.
